relationship.statement: A pendulum's swing period depends only on its length and gravity, growing with the square root of length over gravity. Changing the bob's mass scales both gravitational pull and inertia equally, leaving the swing motion unchanged.
assumptions: Release angle is fixed at 18 degrees in the small-angle regime.
The bob is a point mass on a massless rigid rod.
Air drag and pivot friction are neglected.

quantities.label: String length
quantities.meaning: Distance from the pivot to the center of the test bob.

quantities.label: Bob mass
quantities.meaning: Mass of the test pendulum bob, setting both weight and inertia.

quantities.label: Gravity
quantities.meaning: Gravitational acceleration pulling the test bob downward.

quantities.label: Release angle
quantities.meaning: Starting angle from vertical, held fixed at 18 degrees for both pendulums.

quantities.label: Test period
quantities.meaning: Time for the test pendulum to complete one full back-and-forth swing.

quantities.label: Reference period
quantities.meaning: Swing period of the fixed reference pendulum (1 m, 1 kg, Earth gravity).

quantities.label: Bob weight
quantities.meaning: Downward gravitational force on the test bob, equal to mass times gravity.

quantities.label: Peak speed
quantities.meaning: Maximum speed of the test bob as it passes through the bottom.

quantities.label: Test swing angle
quantities.meaning: Angle of the test pendulum from vertical at time t.

quantities.label: Ref swing angle
quantities.meaning: Angle of the reference pendulum from vertical at time t.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { var L = inputs.length; var m = inputs.mass; var g = inputs.gravity; var REF_L = 1.0; var REF_M = 1.0; var REF_G = 9.8; var START_DEG = 18; var THETA0 = START_DEG * Math.PI / 180; var PIVOT_Y = 2.4; var REF_PIVOT_X = -0.85; var TEST_PIVOT_X = 0.85; var FORCE_SCALE = 0.016; var omega = Math.sqrt(g / L); var refOmega = Math.sqrt(REF_G / REF_L); var period = 2 * Math.PI / omega; var refPeriod = 2 * Math.PI / refOmega; var weight = m * g; var refWeight = REF_M * REF_G; var maxSpeed = THETA0 * Math.sqrt(g * L); var phase = omega * t; var refPhase = refOmega * t; var theta = THETA0 * Math.cos(phase); var refTheta = THETA0 * Math.cos(refPhase); var angleDeg = START_DEG * Math.cos(phase); var refAngleDeg = START_DEG * Math.cos(refPhase); var bobX = TEST_PIVOT_X + L * Math.sin(theta); var bobY = PIVOT_Y - L * Math.cos(theta); var refX = REF_PIVOT_X + REF_L * Math.sin(refTheta); var refY = PIVOT_Y - REF_L * Math.cos(refTheta); var forceEndY = bobY - FORCE_SCALE * weight; var refForceEndY = refY - FORCE_SCALE * refWeight; var plumbEndY = PIVOT_Y - L; var bobSize = 0.08 + 0.24 * m; var refBobSize = 0.08 + 0.24 * REF_M; var periodClose = Math.abs(period - refPeriod) < 0.01; var sameLandG = Math.abs(L - REF_L) < 0.05 && Math.abs(g - REF_G) < 0.05; var diffMass = Math.abs(m - REF_M) > 0.1; var isMatchedDiffMass = periodClose && sameLandG && diffMass; var isMatchedRatio = periodClose && !sameLandG; var isSlower = period >= refPeriod + 0.01; var isFaster = period <= refPeriod - 0.01; return { period: period, refPeriod: refPeriod, weight: weight, refWeight: refWeight, maxSpeed: maxSpeed, angleDeg: angleDeg, refAngleDeg: refAngleDeg, bobX: bobX, bobY: bobY, refX: refX, refY: refY, forceEndY: forceEndY, refForceEndY: refForceEndY, plumbEndY: plumbEndY, bobSize: bobSize, refBobSize: refBobSize, isMatchedDiffMass: isMatchedDiffMass, isMatchedRatio: isMatchedRatio, isSlower: isSlower, isFaster: isFaster }; }

Only L and g set the swing period.

Slower swing: longer L or lower g
Faster swing: shorter L or higher g

lesson.title: What Changes a Pendulum's Swing?
lesson.description: Compare a test pendulum against a fixed reference pendulum while tracking their swing angles over time. Adjust length, bob mass, and gravity to see which ones change the period.
lesson.instructions: Drag String length to lengthen or shorten the rod, Bob mass to resize the bob and gravity arrow, and Gravity to change downward pull. Watch how the test swing and wave curve compare with the 1 m Earth reference.
lesson.goal: Understand that a pendulum's period increases with string length and decreases with gravity, while bob mass has no effect because weight and inertia scale together.
